question: As of July 15, 2026, what GAAP diluted EPS range and adjusted diluted EPS range was Hormel Foods guiding to for fiscal 2026?
grading: Key points (both required): GAAP diluted EPS guidance USD 1.28-1.37 (updated May 28, 2026, previously 1.37-1.46) AND adjusted diluted EPS guidance USD 1.43-1.51 (reaffirmed). Fail if the Aug 27, 2026 ranges (GAAP 1.06-1.12; adjusted 1.45-1.51) are given as in effect on July 15, 2026, or if only one of the two measures is provided.
answer: As of July 15, 2026 the guidance in effect was the one issued with Hormel's Q2 fiscal 2026 results on May 28, 2026: GAAP diluted EPS of USD 1.28-1.37 (lowered from USD 1.37-1.46 to include the loss on the sale of the whole-bird turkey business) and adjusted diluted EPS of USD 1.43-1.51 (reaffirmed; +4% to +10%) for fiscal 2026 (ending October 25, 2026) [H05-E1]. The Q3 update on August 27, 2026 (GAAP USD 1.06-1.12; adjusted USD 1.45-1.51) came after the as_of date [H05-E2]. Between May 28 and July 15 Hormel filed only Item 5.02 officer-change 8-Ks, no guidance changes [H05-E3].

- Hormel said the GAAP EPS guidance update reflects the loss on the sale of the whole-bird turkey business, which is excluded from the adjusted (non-GAAP) measure. [1][5]
- The fiscal 2026 adjusted diluted EPS outlook reconciles from GAAP diluted EPS of $1.28 to $1.37 plus adjustments for the T&M initiative of $0.06 to $0.07, corporate restructuring plan-related charges of $0.01, the Consulting Agreement of $0.01, a gain on the sale of the Justin's branded business of $(0.03), and a loss on the sale of the whole-bird turkey business of $0.09.
